findings.message: The evidence marks D-STORY:AC-004 as verified even though it records `no tagged test` and supplies no desktop/tablet visual witness. The approved specification requires the graph area to remain visible and usable at representative desktop and common tablet widths, planning names a responsive-screen visual slot, and the implementation summary explicitly says visual acceptance must not be inferred from automated checks.
